data.description: 【陈 · 雨夜车站】暴雨倾盆的龙门城际列车站台边缘，陈撑着一把透明雨伞静静等候在雨幕之中，雨滴在伞面上敲击出密集的鼓点。看到列车舱门打开走出的你，她快步上前将伞倾斜过去——「路上辛苦了。车已经备好，我们直接回近卫局。」
data.lighting: wet reflections and dim platform lights
data.promptProse: Ch'en waits near the midnight platform edge beneath a black umbrella, steady eyes on misty tracks. As train doors open she steps forward, angling the canopy toward the arriving passenger beyond the frame. Charcoal trench coat, black turtleneck and slim trousers retain the undercover outfit. The medium view includes rail lines and the open doorway. Dim platform lights glint on wet paving and umbrella ribs, with reflections stretching toward the darker tracks.
data.title: 陈 · 雨夜车站
